[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.agents](../index.html)/[Context](index.html)/runNode

# runNode

common

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

suspend fun [runNode](run-node.html)(node: [Node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/index.html), nodeInput: [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)? = null, runId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, useAsOutput: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, useSubBranch: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, overrideBranch: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, overrideIsolationScope: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, raiseOnWait: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false): [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?

Executes [node](run-node.html) as a child of this node activation and returns its output. When [node](run-node.html) is an agent that hands off with `transfer_to_agent`, the handoffs are followed and the last agent's output is returned.

Child events are recorded under `<thisNodePath>/<node.name>@<runId>`. If [node](run-node.html) fails, this call throws [DynamicNodeFailedException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-dynamic-node-failed-exception/index.html), which fails this node unless the caller catches it. If [node](run-node.html) pauses for input, this call throws an internal [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html) that is not an [Exception](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-exception/index.html), so the runtime can mark this node as waiting; do not catch it with `runCatching` or `catch (t: Throwable)`.

#### Parameters

 _node_

Child node to execute.

_node Input_

Input passed to [node](run-node.html), or `null` if none.

_run Id_

Explicit run ID for [node](run-node.html): at least one non-digit, and no `'/'`, `'@'`, or `'.'`. A child that already recorded an output under the same ID, in this activation, an earlier attempt, or an earlier turn, returns it without running again; one that finished without an output may run again. When `null` or empty, the child gets the next number for its name, which follows call order, so concurrent children need explicit IDs.

_use AsOutput_

When `true`, delegates this node's output to [node](run-node.html). The first output this node produces afterwards (such as returning [node](run-node.html)'s result) is dropped, even if [node](run-node.html) produces none. A second output fails this node. The claim is released only if [node](run-node.html) fails before emitting an output, so a caller that catches the failure may fall back to its own output. Once [node](run-node.html) has emitted, its output is this node's output and successors receive it. A `node {}` outputs it encoded under its output type, as if it had returned it, and fails if it does not decode.

_use SubBranch_

When `true`, runs [node](run-node.html) on a sub-branch `<branch>.<node.name>@<runId>`.

_override Branch_

Branch for [node](run-node.html) to run on instead of this node's branch.

_override IsolationScope_

Isolation scope for [node](run-node.html) to run in instead of this node's scope. When `null`, an [AgentMode.TASK](../-agent-mode/-t-a-s-k/index.html) child of a node activation runs in a scope named by its own node path.

_raise OnWait_

When `true` and [node](run-node.html) is a [Workflow](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-workflow/index.html) or sets [Node.waitForOutput](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/wait-for-output.html) but finishes without an output, aborts this node's run like an interrupt, without recording one: this node completes with any output it already produced, or else waits only if it sets [Node.waitForOutput](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/wait-for-output.html).

#### Throws

[IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html)

if called outside a node activation, if this node does not set `rerunOnResume = true`, or if this node already produced or delegated its output and [useAsOutput](run-node.html) is `true`.

[IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html)

if [node](run-node.html)'s name or [runId](run-node.html) is invalid, if [nodeInput](run-node.html) fails [node](run-node.html)'s input schema, or if a handoff can't be followed: a node that is not an agent requests one, or an agent requests one to itself, to an agent its transfer flags forbid, to a task or single-turn agent, or to an agent that is not its child, parent or peer. A [node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/node.html) child's input check throws [NodeInputValidationException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node-input-validation-exception/index.html) instead. A [parallelNode](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/parallel-node.html) checks each item instead, and a rejected item fails it.

[DynamicNodeFailedException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-dynamic-node-failed-exception/index.html)

if [node](run-node.html) fails; its `error` is the child's failure.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# ExperimentalLiveApi

common

@[RequiresOptIn](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-requires-opt-in/index.html)(message = "The ADK live API is experimental and may change without notice.", level = [RequiresOptIn.Level.ERROR](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-requires-opt-in/-level/-e-r-r-o-r/index.html))

@[Target](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-target/index.html)(allowedTargets = [[AnnotationTarget.CLASS](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-c-l-a-s-s/index.html), [AnnotationTarget.FUNCTION](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-f-u-n-c-t-i-o-n/index.html), [AnnotationTarget.PROPERTY](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y/index.html), [AnnotationTarget.CONSTRUCTOR](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-c-o-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-o-r/index.html), [AnnotationTarget.TYPEALIAS](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-t-y-p-e-a-l-i-a-s/index.html)])

annotation class [ExperimentalLiveApi](index.html)

Marks the live (bidirectional streaming) API, which is experimental and expected to change without notice. Opt in with `@OptIn(ExperimentalLiveApi::class)`.

# ContentInput

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

data class [ContentInput](index.html) @[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html) constructor(val content: [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html), val partial: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false) : [LiveInput](../-live-input/index.html)

A user turn, or the function responses that answer the model's calls.

The constructor throws [IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html) unless [content](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-content-input/--root--.html) has at least one part, carries no function calls, and holds either only function responses or none of them.

# Gemini

common

class [Gemini](index.html) : [Model](../-model/index.html)

Implementation of [Model](../-model/index.html) that interacts with Google Gemini models using the GenAI SDK.

This class provides functionality to generate content from Gemini models, supporting both unary and streaming responses. It can be configured to use either a Google AI API key or Vertex AI credentials for authentication.

GenAI SDK based [Gemini](index.html) currently prevents usage of `API_KEY` and `GoogleCredentials` on Android. Use Firebase AI instead.

Members

## Constructors

[Gemini](-gemini.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

@[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html)

constructor(client: Client, name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), speechConfig: [SpeechConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-speech-config/index.html)? = null)

Creates a [Gemini](-gemini.html) from a preconfigured GenAI SDK Client, for callers that need a custom transport or auth. Each generate request and live connection appends ADK's tracking tag to the client's `user-agent` and `x-goog-api-client` headers. The SDK matches these names exactly, so a client header spelled `User-Agent` replaces the merged value.

@[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html)

constructor(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), apiKey: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, speechConfig: [SpeechConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-speech-config/index.html)? = null)

Creates a [Gemini](-gemini.html) instance using a Google AI API key for authentication. Its client retries transient failures with the GenAI SDK's default retry options; pass your own Client for other retry settings.

@[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html)

constructor(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), vertexCredentials: [VertexCredentials](../-vertex-credentials/index.html), speechConfig: [SpeechConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-speech-config/index.html)? = null)

Creates a [Gemini](-gemini.html) instance using Vertex AI credentials for authentication. Its client retries transient failures with the GenAI SDK's default retry options; pass your own Client for other retry settings.

## Functions

[connect](connect.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

open suspend override fun [connect](connect.html)(request: [LlmRequest](../-llm-request/index.html)): [LiveConnection](../-live-connection/index.html)

Opens a live session configured by [LlmRequest.liveConnectConfig](../-llm-request/live-connect-config.html) (using `request.model` when set), returning once the server confirms setup and throwing if the server refuses it. If the caller is cancelled while the session opens, the session is closed in the background. Reconnection is not handled here, though a Vertex AI resume with `transparent` unset asks for transparent resumption.

# ContextCacheConfig

common

data class [ContextCacheConfig](index.html) @[ExperimentalContextCachingFeature](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-context-caching-feature/index.html) constructor(val cacheIntervals: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html) = 10, val ttl: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html) = 1800.seconds, val minTokens: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html) = 0, val createHttpOptions: [HttpOptions](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-http-options/index.html)? = null)

Configuration for context caching across all agents in an app.

When this config is present on an app, context caching is enabled for all agents. When absent (`null`), context caching is disabled.

Context caching can significantly reduce costs and improve response times by reusing previously processed context across multiple requests.

Constructing this type requires `@OptIn(ExperimentalContextCachingFeature::class)`.

val [cacheIntervals](cache-intervals.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)

Maximum number of invocations to reuse the same cache before refreshing it. Must be in the range `1..100`. Defaults to 10.

[createHttpOptions](create-http-options.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [createHttpOptions](create-http-options.html): [HttpOptions](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-http-options/index.html)?

Optional HTTP options for the cache-creation call. Set this to add a timeout on `CachedContent.create()` calls (e.g. `HttpOptions(timeout = 10.seconds)`). When the cache creation call exceeds the timeout, it fails and the request proceeds without caching. `null` uses the model backend's default HTTP options.

[minTokens](min-tokens.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [minTokens](min-tokens.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)

Minimum prior-request tokens required to enable caching. This gates on the previous request's actual prompt token count (from the model's usage metadata), not an estimate of the current request. Gemini enforces a hard 4096-token minimum that always applies, so values below 4096 have no additional effect. No cache is created on the first request of a session; caching begins on the second turn once a previous token count is known. Context cache storage may have a cost, so set this higher to avoid caching small requests where the overhead may exceed the benefits. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

[ttl](ttl.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [ttl](ttl.html): [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html)

Time-to-live for the cache. Must be strictly positive. Defaults to 30 minutes.

Link copied to clipboard

Returns the TTL in the string format used for cache creation, e.g. `"1800s"`.

# HttpOptions

common

data class [HttpOptions](index.html)(val baseUrl: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val apiVersion: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val headers: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)>? = null, val timeout: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html)? = null)

ADK-owned HTTP transport options for calls a [com.google.adk.kt.models.Model](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-model/index.html) makes to its backend.

This is ADK's own type rather than the backend SDK's, so that configuration surfaces such as [com.google.adk.kt.agents.ContextCacheConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context-cache-config/index.html) stay independent of any particular backend. Implementations translate it to whatever their transport expects.

# connect

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

open suspend fun [connect](connect.html)(request: [LlmRequest](../-llm-request/index.html)): [LiveConnection](../-live-connection/index.html)

Opens a live (bidirectional streaming) connection, configured by [LlmRequest.liveConnectConfig](../-llm-request/live-connect-config.html).

The returned connection is open but not yet primed; send history or content to start the conversation, and close it when it ends.

#### Parameters

 _request_

The request whose live config, model name, system instruction and tools configure the session.

#### Throws

[UnsupportedOperationException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unsupported-operation-exception/index.html)

if this model does not support live connections.

# LiveConnection

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

interface [LiveConnection](index.html) : [AutoCloseable](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/lang/AutoCloseable.html)

An open bidirectional (live) connection to a model, obtained from [Model.connect](../-model/connect.html).

A connection outlives a single turn: opened once, carrying many turns, closed when the conversation ends.

Send methods are called by one writer at a time, but [closeSession](close-session.html) must be safe to call while a send is in flight.

#### Inheritors

[BaseFutureLiveConnection](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.interop/-base-future-live-connection/index.html)

[receive](receive.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

abstract fun [receive](receive.html)(): [Flow](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.coroutines/kotlinx-coroutines-core/kotlinx.coroutines.flow/-flow/index.html)<[LlmResponse](../-llm-response/index.html)>

The model's responses for the current turn, completing when the turn ends; collect it again for the next turn. A collection that completes with no response means the connection has ended. Unlike [Model.generateContent](../-model/generate-content.html), where each collection makes its own request, every collection here reads the same open connection, so only one is allowed at a time: implementations reject a concurrent one with [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html).

Seeds the session with prior conversation; [Model.connect](../-model/connect.html) does not call it, so the caller invokes it at most once, right after connecting and before any other send. The model responds only if the last content is from the user, and otherwise waits for new input.

# close

common

open override fun [close](close.html)()

Blocking [AutoCloseable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-auto-closeable/index.html) bridge to [closeSession](close-session.html), for callers outside a coroutine.

Coroutine code must call [closeSession](close-session.html) instead, typically in a `finally`, and nothing should call this from a main thread, because it blocks until the graceful close finishes. Unlike the GenAI SDK's `LiveSession.close()`, which cancels the socket abruptly, this closes gracefully.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# CacheMetadata

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [CacheMetadata](index.html)(val fingerprint: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val contentsCount: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html), val cacheName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val expireTime: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null, val invocationsUsed: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)? = null, val createdAt: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null)

Metadata for the context cache associated with LLM responses.

This stores cache identification, usage tracking, and lifecycle information for a particular cache instance. It can be in one of two states:

  1. **Active cache state:** [cacheName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) is set and [expireTime](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html), [invocationsUsed](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html), and [createdAt](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) are populated.

  2. **Fingerprint-only state:** [cacheName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) is `null` and only [fingerprint](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) and [contentsCount](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) are set, used for prefix matching before a cache exists.




Token counts (cached and total) are available in [LlmResponse.usageMetadata](../-llm-response/usage-metadata.html) and should be accessed from there to avoid duplication.

# TurnCompleteReason

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)(with = [TurnCompleteReasonSerializer::class](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-turn-complete-reason-serializer/index.html))

enum [TurnCompleteReason](index.html) : [Enum](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-enum/index.html)<[TurnCompleteReason](index.html)>

Why a live turn ended.

Absent on an ordinary completion; present when the turn was cut short, most often by a safety filter on either the input or the generated content.

# Transcription

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [Transcription](index.html)(val text: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val finished: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val languageCode: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val speakerLabel: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val words: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[WordInfo](../-word-info/index.html)>? = null)

A transcription of audio, either the user's input or the model's output.

Transcriptions arrive in chunks: each carries the newest text, and [finished](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-transcription/--root--.html) marks the last chunk of an utterance.
